title: Behavior specifications using ground-truth evaluation repositories
description:
Jira [DATAP-602](https://anthus.atlassian.net/browse/DATAP-602).

As a scanner evaluator, I want executable Gherkin specs against pinned ground-truth GitHub repositories, so that the scanner is judged on known real-world sources rather than only tiny local fixtures.

Example acceptance from the Jira epic:

- Given a repository known to track SSNs
- When I run the scanner
- Then I should get an SSN data item in the data-items evaluation layer (ScanResult personal-data findings)

This epic does not change gold labels, detector logic, or knowledge-graph taxonomy docs. It wires Gherkin to the existing corpus packets under `tests/benchmark/repos/`.
